title: ELIC Monorepo Structure
description: Walks through the package boundaries and data flow in the ELIC monorepo.
goal: Maintain an architecture overview of the active ELIC TypeScript packages and the isolated legacy Neovim adapter.

items.body: The repository root owns the Bun workspace. `packages/*` is the package boundary, and root scripts build packages in dependency order: schema, core, TUI, then CLI.

steps.body: `@elic/schema` is the lowest-level package. It exports the Explanation contract, parser, validation helpers, and shared domain types.
`@elic/core` builds on schema. It owns the file-loading boundary for strict Explanation JSON and does not define a separate surface-shaped data model.
`@elic/tui` owns terminal UI screens. The home screen discovers `.explanation.json` files from the ELIC artifact locations.
`@elic/cli` is the command surface. It loads Explanation JSON with core and reports validation problems through the schema formatter.

items.body: `packages/tourguide.nvim` remains a Legacy Adapter. Its command names and Lua module names are intentionally outside the active ELIC Explanation contract.

steps.body: Validation starts by decoding strict JSON with excess properties rejected, then applies semantic checks such as unique Topic and Flow slugs.
After validation, core returns the Explanation artifact itself. Presentation Surfaces can traverse Topics, Flows, and Steps without changing the artifact contract.
